accepted_findings.reader_payoff: False obstruction can be pictured as fragile yet effective at screening what remains visible.
accepted_findings.containment: Exploratory HFT analogy only; it uses the supplied eye-film and sight facets and never displaces the ordinary path translation.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: An eye-covering membrane resembling a spider web and carrying red vessels.
branch_contributions.actual_contribution: The peripheral focus branch supplies the material web-like obstruction.
branch_contributions.boundary: Exploratory only; ٱلسَّبِيلِ is not translated as an eye disease or web.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: Bodily sight and the eye's act of seeing.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: 29:41: weak covering beside the focus sight carrier
branch_contributions.actual_contribution: The sight facet anchors the analogy in an obstructed perceptual field.
branch_contributions.boundary: It does not erase inward or qualified insight alternatives.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: Shelter and dwelling, including the spider house.
branch_contributions.actual_contribution: The target supplies the woven-house image from which the thin-covering analogy is drawn.
branch_contributions.boundary: Not target lexical analysis; the parable remains independently about its supplied house comparison.

accepted_findings.title: The named peoples can be read as entries in an outcome ledger
accepted_findings.local_before: The focus names ʿAd and Thamud as peoples whose dwellings make their fate visible.
accepted_findings.context_after: 29:40's each-by-offense sequence turns the named cases into individually inspectable entries.
accepted_findings.claim: As a contained split-root resonance, the paired names open a case-by-case register in which each visible trace is linked to an offense and a differentiated outcome.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The proper-name sequence and dwelling evidence meet the target's exhaustive per-case statement; count organizes without etymologizing the names.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: Responsibility and consequence can be tracked case by case instead of as a generic mass event.
accepted_findings.containment: Exploratory split-root formal resonance only; عَادًا remains the proper name of ʿAd, not a count translation; unresolved target branches remain provenance only.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: Counting units to determine a total quantity.
branch_contributions.actual_contribution: The each-case wording supplies the organizing count resonance for the named sequence.
branch_contributions.boundary: The proper name remains a proper name; this is not etymology.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: A clear proof, sign, or inspectable document.
branch_contributions.actual_contribution: Visible dwelling evidence can be read as inspectable case record within the later sequence.
branch_contributions.boundary: No target roots or morphology are inferred.

accepted_findings.title: Clear perception does not guarantee compliant action
accepted_findings.local_before: The focus sets beautified deeds, diversion, and مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ in one tension.
accepted_findings.context_after: 29:39 sets clear proofs beside pride, showing that access to evidence and letting evidence govern action can come apart.
accepted_findings.claim: The sequence distinguishes perceptual or evidentiary clarity from moral uptake: people can remain capable of seeing while pride and beautification govern their deeds.
accepted_findings.mechanism: Local زَيَّنَ ... أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ supplies action change; target بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ ... فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ supplies clear proof met by pride.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader does not flatten مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ into successful guidance or assume visible proof automatically changes conduct.
accepted_findings.containment: New macro finding bounded to 29:38-29:39; no focus word is redefined and target morphology is not analyzed.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: Making something beautiful or making its beauty visible.
branch_contributions.actual_contribution: Active beautification is the action-level force competing with proof.
branch_contributions.boundary: Pride is contextual pressure, not a gloss of زَيَّنَ.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: Good and bad behavior within consciously performed action.
branch_contributions.actual_contribution: Offense-linked outcomes keep beautified deeds within accountable agency.
branch_contributions.boundary: Target root and morphology are not independently analyzed.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: Being conscious, perceptive, and firm in understanding.
branch_contributions.actual_contribution: Perceptive capacity is compatible with failure to let insight govern conduct.
branch_contributions.boundary: The participle is not limited to this specialization.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: An explicit clear proof, sign, or evident document.
branch_contributions.actual_contribution: The context confirms that the obstacle is not absence of clarity.
branch_contributions.boundary: Only supplied surface/context evidence is used.

friction_notes.note: All three HFT records were reviewed and retained with support IDs. Their broader-than-pericope and legacy-unbound qualifications affect epistemic status and containment, not visibility; unresolved branch citations remain attributed provenance.
The webbed-path finding is exploratory and must not displace the ordinary path reading. The case-ledger finding is a split-root formal resonance, not proper-name etymology.
29:41 supports several findings, but their payoffs remain distinct: fitted structure, social protection, cross-scale false stability, and thin webbed-path analogy.
Connection targets supply exact Arabic surface evidence but no target morphology or lexical analysis; target-side claims remain at the supplied contextual level.
The 29:42 reciprocal counterevidence was independently rejected for the focus direction and remains visible as a failed edge; it does not veto the separate 29:41 protective-shelter contact.
The automatically included 29:0 basmala was scanned and rejected as a generic prefatory frame because no non-generic focus-local carrier or changed reading was supplied.

Non-candidate focus branches, including remaining beautification, adversarial-agent, being/state, alternate proper-name, and unrelated body/material branches, were scanned; only the emitted action, deed, stasis, and clarity facets had bounded contextual edges.
